authorization: Additional one-node debug family, independent of the active small-grid debug-scaling controller; pilots excluded from cross-grid table.
seed_mapping: Literal training seed0; data generation seed42.

recipe.global_fair_ES: All distinct ordered sample pairs within each origin, all 24 hours, original masks and train-derived scales
recipe.exception: case2000 is an explicitly authorized global K=2 pilot, covariance rank8 unchanged; not sample-parallel K8.

training.budget_definition: Startup, training, selection and checkpoint wall time across all attempts; queue wait, data preparation and evaluation excluded and separately reported. Lost attempts conservatively charged a full hour and parked.
training.resume: Atomic checkpoints; exact manifest, model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG restoration; preserve epoch order and counters. Source snapshot and full configuration hashes checked before every worker.
training.failure_policy: Park the affected chain/grid on scientific failure or unexpected worker exit; do not retry a failed optimizer state or relax any audit. Other chains continue.
training.budget_justification: Synthetic step estimates imply about7.8h for six epochs before selection/startup overhead; twelve worker hours bounds the pilot without promising completion. Patience3 and epoch cap6 apply.

pretraining_gates: CPU parity against official Graphkit CLI and independent OPFData conversion
checked cold/warm/graph-roundtrip solves and dual-sign/units perturbation
full Stage A audit and retained pilot prefix
data.threshold_justification: Unchanged existing Stage A protocols and solver checks; no new scientific acceptance tolerance.
data.headline_rule: All risk-calibration hourly components with >=5 positive days, >=5 negative days and prevalence <0.95; thermal components must also be rated. No test-based choice, top-N selection or fallback when empty.
data.generation: Both grids: fixed v4 law, 200-hour solver pilot then all10080 hours across all20 episodes; four processes per grid own disjoint episode lists index modulo4. Atomic25-hour shards; exact demand/time/prefix verification before continuation.
data.parity_scope: First32 sorted local/official test-intersection snapshots, CPU batch1; all32 independently checked against official parquet, hashes for all accessed cache groups. This bounded integration check is not full-intersection parity. Existing numerical tolerances unchanged.
data.temporal_audit: Full10080-hour independent physical audit, retained200-hour prefix, source-calendar separation,72 held-out forecast days. No shortened temporal audit.
data.cache_resume: Atomic per-episode embeddings, train/selection only; completed episodes reused after checksum/key validation; current incomplete cache episode recomputed.

job.launcher: One MPI launcher rank, two independent tile-isolated worker processes using xpu:0.
job.layout: case500 seed0 tile0 K8; case2000 seed0 tile2 K2 pilot. Each grid starts training only after its own audit. Up to four Ipopt subprocesses per grid, eight total, one Julia thread each.
job.resubmission: Independent detached controller checks PBS every30s and submits next one-hour debug allocation at each boundary while work and budget remain. No changes to or dependencies on debug-scaling family.
job.status: GENCO/runs/pilots/STATUS.md at every boundary and controller update

compute_before_training: pilot routing, budgets, next-job submission fixtures
interrupted/resumed synthetic shard prefix and tamper detection
existing fleet, case identity, multigrid, V2 harness and Stage1 mechanism tests
Stage A evidence gates before each grid trains
verification.preservation: Original multigrid working tree and index untouched; all fleet workers execute a hashed snapshot from a separate worktree. Historical released v3/v4 manifests/checkpoints/data are protected by hashes.
verification.pass_fail: Passing tests and all Stage A gates authorize each pilot. Missing dependency, solver worker failure, failed audit, nonfinite training or unexpected worker exit parks only the affected grid; no tolerance relaxation. Return75 is a clean allocation boundary, not a scientific failure.
